goals.goal: Maintain a documented, published, and operationally enforced coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy for the company's SaaS product with digital elements, covering intake, triage, and post-disclosure verification across the product's support period.
goals.source: CRA Annex I Part II (5); CRA Art. 13(8) sentence 6
goals.adjustment: Restated from the CRA Sub-SO (SG-D-02.3.CRA) for a single-product, 8-person manufacturer; the "enforce" element (intake-channel evidence, triage-log records, post-disclosure verification artefacts) is retained at the scale of one product line rather than a multi-product portfolio; the NIS 2 Art. 12(1) CSIRT-coordinated pathway referenced in the baseline HL is inapplicable because NIS 2 is not confirmed for this entity.

goals.goal: Achieve public disclosure of information about fixed vulnerabilities (description, affected products, impacts, severity, remediation guidance) once a security update is made available, with any delay recorded under the duly justified delay-justification framework.
goals.source: CRA Annex I Part II (4); CRA Art. 14(9)
goals.adjustment: Restated from the CRA Sub-SO for a single-product manufacturer; the disclosure content set is unchanged; the delay exception is categories-based per Art. 14(9) delegated acts rather than a blanket deferral; no NIS 2 Art. 23(4) incident-reporting cascade applies (NIS 2 not confirmed).

goals.goal: Maintain a publicly identifiable contact address for vulnerability reporting and a designated single point of contact enabling security researchers and users to communicate directly and rapidly with the manufacturer.
goals.source: CRA Annex I Part II (6); CRA Art. 13(17); CRA Annex II §2
goals.adjustment: Restated from the CRA Sub-SO for a single-product, 8-person manufacturer; the SPOC is a named individual or small team rather than a dedicated researcher-relations unit; the contact address is machine-discoverable (security.txt or well-known URI) at the scale of one product domain.
